allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Initial commit: House of Novels - AI-powered novel generation pipeline

Multi-phase story generation system:
- Phase 0: Codex generation \(multi-agent debate\)
- Phase 1: Story outline \(3-act structure\)
- Phase 2: Characters & locations
- Phase 3: Narrative writing
- Phase 3b: Storyboard generation
- Phase 4: Image/video prompt generation
- Phase 5: ComfyUI media generation
- Phase 6: Video editing \(MoviePy\)

Features:
- GENERATION_STEPS binary mask for step control
- LangChain/LangGraph agent orchestration
- ComfyUI integration for image/video generation

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: character/location name mapping in scene image prompts

- Fix name_mapping in name_agents.py to map FULL role descriptions
  \("the protagonist" -> "Yara Ridgewell"\) not just extracted partials
- Add character ID and location ID lookup in scene_image_prompt_agents
- Filter out generic descriptions \(e.g., "community members"\) from
  character lists to keep names/ids synchronized
- Update phase4_prompts.py to save location_id and character_ids
- Add lookup_character_by_role tool for role-to-name resolution
EOF
\)")

Bash(cmd /c "set HOUSE_OF_NOVELS_ENV=prod && python -c ""from src.config import ENVIRONMENT, DEFAULT_YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST; print\(f''Environment: {ENVIRONMENT}''\); print\(f''Playlist: {DEFAULT_YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST}''\)""")
Bash(do if python -c "import json; c=json.load\(open\(''$f''\)\); print\(''$f:'', ''Step1'' if c.get\(''story'',{}\).get\(''outline'',{}\).get\(''structure_beats''\) else ''No Step1''\)")
